title: Audit Request
description: Validated intake payload that starts a Prysm audit. Schema version 1.0.0.

contractVersion.description: Contract version — must match the schema version.

auditId.description: Unique audit identifier assigned at intake.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-supplied key that prevents duplicate audit creation.

market.description: Primary market or location string (e.g. city and region).

language.description: BCP 47 language tag for the report.

primaryGoal.description: Primary business goal for this audit.

ga4.description: Optional GA4 property selection. oauthService/fetchImpl are controlled-dependency injection seams (tests only).

siteUrl.description: Google Search Console site URL or sc-domain property.

gsc.description: Optional GSC property selection. oauthService/fetchImpl are controlled-dependency injection seams (tests only).

enableContentParsing.description: PRYSM-NEXT-01 WP-B: enable DFS content parsing at task level. Requests are scoped to the deterministic key-page set only.

validateMicromarkup.description: PRYSM-NEXT-01 WP-B: enable DFS micromarkup validation so the microdata endpoint returns structured data.

contentParsingPageLimit.description: PRYSM-NEXT-01 WP-B: runtime budget for governed task-scoped Content Parsing pages.

redirectChainsPageLimit.description: PRYSM-NEXT-01 WP-B: max pages checked for redirect chains (key pages + 3xx pages).

nonIndexableLimit.description: PRYSM-NEXT-01 WP-B: max non-indexable page records collected.

resourcesPageLimit.description: PRYSM-NEXT-01 WP-B: max key pages inspected for resource/broken-resource evidence.

pathValidationEnabled.description: PRYSM-NEXT-01 WP-E: enable the narrow Playwright conversion-path validation layer (read-only; never submits).

pathValidationPageLimit.description: PRYSM-NEXT-01 WP-E: max key pages browser-validated.

pathValidationScreenshots.description: PRYSM-NEXT-01 WP-E: capture controlled desktop screenshots into governed evidence artifacts.

pathValidationMobile.description: PRYSM-NEXT-01 WP-E: run the mobile viewport pass.

pathValidationLiveBrowser.description: PRYSM-NEXT-01 WP-E: explicit production opt-in to launch a real browser. Default false — controlled tests never launch browsers.

crawl.description: Crawl configuration overrides. fixtures/fetchImpl/localRunner are controlled-dependency injection seams (tests only); production defaults are unchanged.

performance.description: Performance configuration. fetchImpl/localRunner are controlled-dependency injection seams (tests only).

serp.description: SERP configuration. fetchImpl is a controlled-dependency injection seam (tests only).

backlinks.description: Backlinks configuration. fetchImpl is a controlled-dependency injection seam (tests only).

designVersion.description: PRYSM-NEXT-01 WP-G: governed report design version. 1.0.0 = locked v1 design (default); 2.0.0 = prysm-report-design-v2.0.0.

narrativeVersion.description: PRYSM Narrative v2 production-path gate. 1.0.0 keeps the existing narrative/render path; 2.0.0 explicitly selects the governed Writer/Judge narrative layer when the runtime capability is enabled.

report.description: Report configuration. Design and narrative versions are independently governed; both default to the existing production path.
